page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmc7.32xlarge is a bare-metal instance featuring 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. This configuration operates on a KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware.

For network connectivity, the instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. The lack of local storage requires reliance on external block storage solutions, which represents a key architectural tradeoff. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of dedicated compute cores relative to memory makes this instance profile suitable for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local disk storage.

The hardware profile makes the ecs.ebmc7.32xlarge suitable for compute-intensive workloads. These include high-performance computing, batch processing, scientific modeling, and large-scale web serving or application hosting where parallel processing power is prioritized over local storage and high memory-to-CPU ratios.
